desc: Ideation: choose approach (offline union-of-segments beats DSU/next-pointer; bucket+visited-set is O(M·N) and rejected)
Implement the full offline solution (I/O + simulation + interval merge per key + per-house bisect coverage test + output)

Verify correctness by hand-tracing both samples and edge cases: endpoints/turning points included, touching intervals merged via `lo <= ce`, double-covered house counted once via `continue`, negative and out-of-range coordinates handled by big ints and empty bisect results
Performance check: O((N+M) log(N+M)) with per-key merged parallel arrays; worst case (all houses on one line) is a single sorted list plus binary searches — safe at N=M=2·10⁵
Optional cross-check against brute force — deemed unnecessary; logic reduces exactly to union-of-segments coverage
